scope: Four independent first-phase formal runs; tokenizer NLL values are not an architecture ranking.
training_curve_sampling: First row, every logged step divisible by 50, and latest train row; all validation records retained. Original full logs remain local.
throughput_scope: Arithmetic mean of the latest 20 logged update rates; excludes evaluation/checkpoint/wait time, not a whole-stage benchmark.
eta_scope: Remaining first-phase updates only; excludes evaluation, checkpoints, waiting and later phases.
